business_problem: Bitvavo needed to scale real-time trading data while preserving encryption, governance, and regulatory compliance across multiple domains without self-managing Kafka infrastructure.
solution_summary: Bitvavo adopted Confluent's fully managed Kafka platform to replace an increasingly difficult open-source deployment in a business where trading, encryption, and regulation all converge. The streaming platform now carries real-time trading data across domains while preserving the different encryption and data governance rules each domain must respect. Schema Registry and Confluent's governance capabilities help the exchange enforce data contracts and integrity across those streams, while the managed platform gives the team elastic capacity for market spikes and less operating-system-level maintenance work. This architecture supports event-driven processing across Bitvavo's exchange so trading charts, market data, and internal data systems stay fresher and safer. It also gives the company a stronger footing for GDPR and DORA compliance while handling very large transaction volumes and continuing to grow its user base.

solution_components.name: Confluent fully managed Kafka platform
solution_components.role: Runs Bitvavo's real-time trading and domain-specific data streams without self-managed infrastructure.

solution_components.name: Schema Registry
solution_components.role: Helps enforce data contracts, governance policies, and compatibility across Bitvavo's regulated data flows.

data_flow: Trading events stream through Confluent across Bitvavo's domains, where governed schemas and encryption controls keep the data usable for charts, market-data delivery, and internal systems while preserving regulatory requirements.
business_outcome: Bitvavo improved market-data freshness, strengthened governance and compliance, handled growth and market spikes more smoothly, and reduced the operational drag of securing and scaling its trading infrastructure.
metrics: EUR 1.5 billion in trading volume per day
architecture_clues: Different business domains keep their own encryption and governance policies on top of shared streaming infrastructure.
The platform auto-scales to handle rapid market growth and spikes.
Real-time candle charts became practical once the streaming backbone was centralized and governed.
evidence_quotes: Reaching up to EUR 1.5 billion in trading volume per day across its platform.
Confluent's solution enabled Bitvavo to implement event-driven architecture and real-time data processing across their platform.
The platform's robust data governance tools and features like Schema Registry and stream processing empowered Bitvavo to implement the strict data policies they required.
Bitvavo is now able to provide users with trading data in milliseconds without delays, including updates for trading charts, whereas previously this could take up to 3 minutes.
